mechanism: Chloroquine may increase valproic acid levels through hepatic metabolism inhibition and protein binding displacement, while valproic acid may increase chloroquine levels, creating potential for toxicity of both agents.
action: Monitor serum valproic acid and chloroquine levels closely; consider therapeutic drug monitoring and assess for signs of valproic acid toxicity (tremor, ataxia, mental changes) and chloroquine toxicity (visual changes, cardiac arrhythmias); consider alternative antimalarial if possible.
